tools.name: cancel_and_notify_patient
tools.description: Deletes an appointment from the schedule and emails the patient a cancellation notice with the given reason.

params.name: appt_id
params.description: ID of the appointment to delete

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason included in the email to the patient

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB = "clinic.db"


def cancel_and_notify_patient(appt_id: int, reason: str) -> str:
    cn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    r = cn.execute(
        "SELECT p.email, p.name, a.starts_at FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE a.id = ?",
        (appt_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if not r:
        cn.close()
        return "appointment not found"
    cn.execute("DELETE FROM appointments WHERE id = ?", (appt_id,))
    cn.commit()
    cn.close()
    em, nm, ts = r
    m = EmailMessage()
    m["From"] = "scheduling@clinic.example.com"
    m["To"] = em
    m["Subject"] = "Your appointment has been cancelled"
    m.set_content(f"Hello {nm},\n\nYour appointment on {ts} was cancelled.\nReason: {reason}\n")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.clinic.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(m)
    return f"cancelled {appt_id} and notified {em}"

tools.name: move_appointment_to_archive_and_list
tools.description: Looks up a patient's completed appointments before a cutoff date, moves them from the active appointments table to the archive table, and returns the moved rows.

params.name: before_date
params.description: ISO date; completed appointments before this are archived

tools.code:
import sqlite3

DB = "clinic.db"


def move_appointment_to_archive_and_list(patient_id: int, before_date: str) -> list:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    params = (patient_id, before_date)
    where = "patient_id = ? AND status = 'completed' AND starts_at < ?"
    rows = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(f"SELECT id, starts_at, provider_id, status FROM appointments WHERE {where}", params)]
    conn.execute(f"INSERT INTO appointments_archive SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE {where}", params)
    conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM appointments WHERE {where}", params)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return rows
